model.name: Nike Metcon 10 - Women's
model.description:
No weak points. No wasted energy. The Nike Metcon 10 is your foundation for conquering every cross-training session. Featuring a midsole rubber wrap that is more tuned, lighter, and less bulky than the Metcon 9, these shoes help you dominate your toughest workouts. The updated midsole with a lightweight ReactX foam maximizes energy return, while the ultra-strong Hyperlift plate under the heel ensures optimal stability for heavy lifts. The sturdy heel cup and lace tuck allow you to focus on your form—no shifting, no slipping, just locked-in control with every rep. The flex grooves on the outsole give you the flexibility to crush box jumps, sprints, and high-intensity movements without missing a beat. Engineered for excellence, the Nike Metcon 10 ensures every step fuels your progress.

Nike Metcon 10 features:

  • Open-holed engineered mesh offers breathability.
  • Wider toe box compared to the Metcon 9 helps toes extend outward and optimizes performance.
  • Midfoot band provides a secure fit.
  • Sticky texture strategically placed on the midfoot and toe delivers durability.
  • Tough plastic heel clip maximizes durability.
  • New traction pattern ensures grip on sweaty surfaces.

When heavy lifts, circuits, and gym training are on the agenda, this shoe helps you stay grounded, stable, and ready to move with confidence. The Nike Metcon 10 updates the training favorite with a lighter, less bulky midsole wrap, responsive ReactX foam, a Hyperlift plate under the heel, and flex grooves that support both strength work and quick transitions.

  • Open-holed engineered mesh helps keep airflow moving.
  • Wider toe box than the Metcon 9 is designed to let toes spread more naturally.
  • Midfoot band adds a secure, locked-in feel.
  • Sticky texture on the midfoot and toe helps reinforce high-wear areas.
  • Tough heel construction and a lace tuck help keep your setup secure.
  • Updated traction pattern is built for grip on gym surfaces.

Size & Fit Guidance

For the best fit, we recommend going up a half size, as many reviewers found that gave them the right amount of length for training. Some preferred a full size up for extra toe room, while shoppers who like a very close, locked-in fit sometimes stayed with their usual size.

Best For

Best for lifting, strength training, HIIT, and gym sessions where stability and grip matter more than plush cushioning.

Styling & Versatility

A sleek, low-profile shape gives the Metcon 10 a cleaner look than many training shoes, so it feels just as easy to wear for errands or all-day routines as it does in the gym. Details like the lace tuck keep the look streamlined and distraction-free.

Break-In & Durability

Reviewers consistently call out the strong, supportive build and durable feel. Some say it benefits from a few wears to fully break in, with the structured upper and firm platform feeling more natural after a handful of sessions.

Care & Maintenance

Reviewers found the upper easy to wipe down, so regular spot cleaning is a simple way to keep it looking fresh. Clearing debris from the outsole tread can also help preserve confident grip for training.

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx:
Unfortunately, there is no international sizing standard. Sizes vary from country to country. Please use the tables above only as a guide to help you in ordering the correct size. Please note that all sizes, are listed and sold in US sizes., |

Women's shoes are made on a narrower last (the foot-shaped form used in making shoes) than men's. In addition, the heel on a woman's shoe is narrower than the forefoot width. Men's shoes have the same width at the forefoot and heel. The medium width for women's shoes is B, while the medium width for men's shoes is D.

Women can wear men's shoes by converting their size to men's by subtracting 1.5 from their numeric size. For example, if you are a size 8 in women's, you would try a 6.5 in men's sizes. This is a loose conversion and doesn't change the difference in width and forefoot-to-heel ratios.

, | If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit.
